claims.evidence: Gold lettering is visible but not legible enough to confirm brand or model.
No maker's mark or nameplate is legible in the photo to confirm country of origin.
Photo shows a manual treadle (foot-pedal) mechanism with no visible motor; mechanism movement or sound cannot be judged from a still image.

claims.claim: All accessories and original manual included
claims.evidence: No accessories, bobbins, or manual are visible in the photo; none shown alongside the machine.

claims.claim: Never serviced because nothing ever went wrong
claims.evidence: Maintenance history cannot be assessed from a photo; no service records or internal views shown.

risks.risk: Mechanism may not turn smoothly or stitch correctly
risks.proof: A short video of the treadle being pedaled and the needle/arm moving, ideally stitching on scrap fabric

risks.risk: Belt, needle, or bobbin missing or worn
risks.proof: Close-up photos of belt, needle, and bobbin area
risks.if_unproven: priced as missing/worn, requiring replacement parts

risks.risk: Hidden rust or damage on treadle base or underside of table
risks.proof: Photos of underside of table and full treadle base from multiple angles

risks.risk: Table hinges/folding mechanism may be loose or broken
risks.proof: Video of table being folded/unfolded showing hinge movement

risks.risk: Accessories (bobbins, needles, manual) may not actually be included
risks.proof: Photo of accessories and manual laid out next to the machine

risks.risk: Brand/origin claim could be inflated to raise price
risks.proof: Clear close-up photo of nameplate/decal confirming brand and 'Made in Japan' marking
risks.if_unproven: priced as unbranded/unverified origin, not as a premium Japanese model

proof_requests: Close-up clear photo of the gold lettering/decal on the machine head
Video of the treadle being pedaled and the machine stitching on scrap fabric
Photos of belt, needle, bobbin, and bobbin case
Photos of underside of table and full treadle base, including any rust spots
Video of the table folding/unfolding to show hinge condition
Photo of all included accessories and the original manual laid out together
response.reason: The witness confirms this is a manual treadle sewing machine, so it can be priced at worst case for an unverified-brand, unserviced, unknown-condition unit, pending the listed proofs to raise the price.
